search_text: published ZDI-17-972 ZDI-CAN-4789 Trend Micro Mobile Security for Enterprise clt_report_sms_status Uninitialized Pointer Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2017-12-13 CVE-2017-14082 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2017-14082 6.4 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:P/I:N/A:P ['Trend Micro'] ['Mobile Security for Enterprise'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on vulnerable installations of Trend Micro Mobile Security for Enterprise. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within processing of the clt_report_sms_status action. The issue results from the lack of proper initialization of a pointer prior to accessing it. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose sensitive information in the context of the current process. Trend Micro has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Trend Micro Mobile Security for Enterprise clt_report_sms_status Uninitialized Pointer Information Disclosure Vulnerability
